## Solution

<!-- prep:solutions:start -->
<details>
<summary><b>Java</b> (spoiler) · <code>1431-kids-with-the-greatest-number-of-candies.java</code></summary>

```java
class Solution {
    public List<Boolean> kidsWithCandies(int[] candies, int extraCandies) {
        int maximum = 0;
        int n = candies.length;
        ArrayList<Boolean> result =  new ArrayList<Boolean>();

        for(int i = 0; i < n; i++){
            maximum = Math.max(candies[i], maximum);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i ++){
            int count = candies[i] + extraCandies; 
            if(count >= maximum){
                result.add(true);
            }else{
                result.add(false);
            }
        }

        return result;
        
    }
}
```

</details>
